name.fr: Mygale à pattes rouges du Costa Rica

overview.en: The inventory name Megaphobema mesomelas is an older combination; the World Spider Catalog accepts Abdomegaphobema mesomelas, a Costa Rican tarantula.
overview.fr: Le nom d’inventaire Megaphobema mesomelas est une ancienne combinaison ; le World Spider Catalog accepte Abdomegaphobema mesomelas, une mygale du Costa Rica.

identification.en: The World Spider Catalog confirms the accepted species and its Costa Rican distribution; the common name refers to the contrasting reddish legs.
identification.fr: Le World Spider Catalog confirme le nom accepté et la répartition costaricienne ; son nom commun évoque le contraste des pattes rougeâtres.

habitat.en: A Costa Rican natural-history record describes it from forested areas and burrows in holes made by other animals or dug into vertical banks.
habitat.fr: Une source costaricienne la signale en milieu forestier, dans des cavités creusées par d’autres animaux ou dans des terriers qu’elle aménage sur des talus verticaux.

diet.en: It is a predator of small animals; a study from Monteverde examined its prey choices and found that prey type and abundance did not alone predict preference.
diet.fr: C’est un prédateur de petits animaux ; une étude menée à Monteverde a montré que le type et l’abondance des proies ne suffisaient pas à expliquer ses préférences.

behavior.en: It is a burrowing, ground-dwelling tarantula; observations outside the burrow are reported during the breeding season.
behavior.fr: C’est une mygale terricole qui creuse un terrier ; des observations hors du terrier sont signalées pendant la période de reproduction.

reproduction.en: Species-specific breeding details remain poorly documented in the sources consulted.
reproduction.fr: Les sources consultées documentent peu les détails de sa reproduction.

ecology.en: As a ground predator, it feeds on other animals and is part of the forest-floor food web.
ecology.fr: Comme prédateur du sol, elle consomme d’autres animaux et participe au réseau trophique du sous-bois.

conservation.en: The World Spider Catalog records the species in Costa Rica but does not assign a conservation category.
conservation.fr: Le World Spider Catalog signale l’espèce au Costa Rica, mais ne lui attribue aucune catégorie de conservation.

facts: The catalog accepts Abdomegaphobema mesomelas, gives Costa Rica as its distribution, and records its 2023 transfer from Megaphobema to Abdomegaphobema.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.fr: Habitat — articles sur la mygale à pattes rouges du Costa Rica, Encyclopedia of Life (INBio)

facts: INBio account in Spanish says it frequents forest, can use animal-made cavities, and can make burrows in vertical banks; it is seen crossing nearby roads during breeding periods.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.fr: Préférences alimentaires de Megaphobema mesomelas — dépôt numérique de l’Université de Floride du Sud

facts: The Monteverde study reports prey-selection experiments and concludes that preferences depend on several factors, not abundance alone; the thesis record gives no species-level conservation status.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The inventory and parent taxonomy tree retain Megaphobema mesomelas, but the World Spider Catalog changed its accepted placement to Abdomegaphobema in 2023.
The prey study is an undergraduate field project from one Costa Rican site; its results should not be generalized to all populations or seasons.
No reliable current conservation assessment was found in the consulted sources.
review_note: Preserves the catalogue identifier and scientific field for integration while explaining the current accepted genus; habitat source is Spanish INBio material reproduced by EOL.
